ui.title: Explore
ui.headline: Explore xopc
ui.description: From the first step to ongoing work.
ui.metaDescription: Explore eight areas and 47 capabilities in xopc, from setup, personal understanding and durable tasks to coding, terminal access, workflows and automation.
ui.journeyDescription: Follow the capabilities that support a real outcome.
ui.mindHint: Drag to pan · Click a branch to expand · Select a feature for details
ui.canvasLabel: Mind map canvas. Arrow keys pan, plus and minus zoom, and zero fits the map.
ui.root: Personal AI for the one-person company
ui.videoNote: Official demo footage; the interface may differ from the current release.
ui.updated: Based on September 2026 product documentation. Availability varies by release, platform and configuration.
ui.architectureNote: Projects provide context, Tasks carry outcomes, and Sessions retain conversations. Permissions and human judgment apply at every layer.

start.title: Start
start.description: Connect first, then bring one real thing you want to move forward.

understand.title: Context
understand.description: Build shared context you can inspect, confirm and correct.

work.title: Work
work.description: Chat captures the thought, Tasks carry outcomes, and Projects connect context.

initiative.title: Follow-up
initiative.description: Reuse proven methods and follow up within clear boundaries.

capability.title: Capabilities
capability.description: Combine the right assistant, methods and actions for the work.

connect.title: Connections
connect.description: Connect authorized sources, tools and purpose-built applications.

access.title: Devices
access.description: Different surfaces connect to one Gateway and persistent context.

trust.title: Privacy
trust.description: Permissions, data ownership and inspectable records run through the product.

onboard.title: First steps · Onboarding
onboard.description: Connect one model and bring one real thing you want to move forward.
steps: Find the smallest credible next step
onboard.boundary: You do not need channels, automations or extra Agents before your first conversation.

models.title: Models & services
models.description: Choose the model that thinks with you and configure services for different kinds of work.
steps: Configure credentials or a local endpoint
models.boundary: Local storage does not imply local inference. Cloud models process the context selected for a request.

discovery.title: Connect recent work
discovery.description: Find evidence-backed next steps in the sources you explicitly choose.
discovery.boundary: Experimental. Apple Notes, Calendar and Reminders each need separate system permission; behavior varies by release.

home.title: Today · Workbench
home.description: See decisions that need you, prepared results and work progressing in the background.
steps: Open the related task or follow-up
home.boundary: The workbench reflects your instance's tasks and assistant activity; it is not a separate task-status system.

portrait.title: Your portrait
portrait.description: Edit explicit personal details such as your name, role, language and time zone.
portrait.boundary: Explicit profile fields are presented separately from inferred understanding.

understanding.title: Shared understanding
understanding.description: Keep the assistant's understanding grounded in evidence and open to correction.
steps: Check its source and time horizon
Retire it when no longer useful
understanding.boundary: Inference is not fact. Your direct statements carry greater authority.

memory.title: Work memory
memory.description: Retain project facts, decisions, lessons and open questions so you can stop repeating context.
memory.boundary: Raw messages and documents stay in the source index. The complete user model is not sent with every request.

goals.title: Goals & current priorities
goals.description: Distinguish long-term outcomes from what deserves attention right now.
steps: Use it to guide the work
goals.boundary: These are parts of user understanding, not a separate project-management system.

rules.title: Collaboration rules
rules.description: Set expectations for communication, execution and when the assistant should stop and ask.
steps: Change or disable it when needed
rules.boundary: Explicit rules take priority over inference but do not replace enforced tool permissions.

chat.title: Chat · Session
chat.description: Start naturally, keep working context and return to the conversation later.
steps: Continue or create a durable task
chat.boundary: Not every conversation needs a Task. Reset archives the old transcript; deletion is a separate action.

capture.title: Capture a thought
capture.description: Share text, a file, a link or voice before turning it into a structured action.
steps: Drop in a thought or material
Create a task when it needs to persist
capture.boundary: Supported inputs depend on the client and configured model capabilities.

voice.title: Voice input & calls
voice.description: Continue the same Chat by speaking, dictating or listening.
steps: Continue the same Chat after hanging up
voice.boundary: Natural voice mode has no tools; current-assistant mode retains Agent tools. Stopping playback does not undo completed actions.

tasks.title: Task
tasks.description: Carry a verifiable outcome across time with status, next steps and completion criteria.
tasks.boundary: An Agent run ending does not mean a Task is complete. Completion depends on a verifiable result.

projects.title: Project
projects.description: Connect related tasks, conversations and materials through shared context.
projects.boundary: Projects provide context rather than a competing task-status system.

notes.title: Notes & workspace files
notes.description: Keep source material, decisions and deliverables available for future work.
steps: Let the assistant read or edit it
notes.boundary: Use Notes for durable information and workspace files for material to read, edit or deliver.

sharing.title: Share a conversation
sharing.description: Create a reviewed, read-only snapshot for other people to view.
sharing.boundary: A share exposes the reviewed snapshot. Reachability depends on the delivery method and Gateway configuration.

assistant.title: Assistant work
assistant.description: See what the assistant is following, what it has prepared and where it needs your judgment.
assistant.boundary: Proactive capabilities are evolving. An unchanged polling result is not automatically a useful notification.

followup.title: Ongoing follow-up
followup.description: Resurface unfinished commitments or new signals at a useful time.
followup.boundary: Authority grows from observation to reminders and suggestions. External writes require explicit authorization.

workflows.title: Workflow
workflows.description: Turn a repeatable method into a sequence you can inspect, publish and run again.
steps: Describe a process or choose a template
workflows.boundary: A Workflow defines how work happens. Historical runs retain the published revision used at their start.

automations.title: Automation
automations.description: Start defined work at a chosen time or when an event arrives.
steps: Choose an Agent, Workflow or browser task
Set the trigger and time zone
automations.boundary: An Automation defines when work starts. It does not expand Agent authority, and the Gateway must be running.

browser-auto.title: Browser automations
browser-auto.description: Save a website task you have completed successfully with the assistant so it can run again.
steps: Run again or add a schedule
browser-auto.boundary: You must complete login and human verification. Website changes or expired sessions may break saved tasks.

heartbeat.title: Heartbeat checks
heartbeat.description: Periodically review a short checklist and report only useful changes.
heartbeat.boundary: For lightweight awareness, not exact-time scheduling or critical monitoring.

agents.title: Agent
agents.description: Configure a named assistant's role, models, workspace and capability boundaries.
steps: Use it in its assigned sessions
agents.boundary: There are two configuration layers: global defaults and explicit Agent overrides. Existing sessions do not silently change Agent.

tools.title: Action tools
tools.description: Let the assistant read and edit files, search, run commands and perform real work.
tools.boundary: Available tools depend on policy, credentials and optional dependencies.

skills.title: Skill
skills.description: Package methods, instructions and reference material for a recurring kind of work.
skills.boundary: Skills describe how to work; tools provide actions. They are different layers of capability.

browser.title: Browser use
browser.description: Let an authorized assistant inspect pages, find information and interact with websites.
steps: Save it for reuse when useful
browser.boundary: A browser may use signed-in accounts. Site access and sensitive actions need their own boundaries.

media.title: Image, search & speech
media.description: Add image creation, information retrieval and speech services to the main model.
media.boundary: Services require their own credentials and may incur separate usage charges.

runtimes.title: Tool runtimes
runtimes.description: Supply Node.js and Python for Skills, code tools and local MCP servers.
runtimes.boundary: This is supporting infrastructure. Configure it when a capability requires it.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.description: Give selected Agents access to authorized sources and external service actions.
steps: Assign it to the right Agent
connectors.boundary: Removing a connector may not revoke the external grant. Available services depend on your instance's catalog.

mcp.title: MCP connections
mcp.description: Connect external tools through MCP and expose xopc to other MCP clients.
mcp.boundary: A connection supplies capabilities; execution is still subject to Agent policy and server permissions.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Add channels, tools, providers or interface capabilities to the product.
extensions.boundary: Extensions cross a code-trust boundary. Do not treat unknown extension code as ordinary reference material.

local-apps.title: Local apps
local-apps.description: Open local application workbenches and explore tools built around your own work.
local-apps.boundary: Page entry points exist. Isolated services, releases and rollback must be verified per version; design documents do not imply full delivery.

platform.title: XOPC Platform
platform.description: Optionally connect to hosted services from XOPC Cloud or a private enterprise platform.
platform.boundary: Services depend on the platform deployment, account and published routes.

desktop.title: Desktop app
desktop.description: Use xopc on your own computer as the primary surface for personal work.
desktop.boundary: Local configuration and state use the shared ~/.xopc root by default.

web.title: Web console
web.description: Use a browser to access the workbench, conversations, projects and settings.
web.boundary: Connect to the intended Gateway. Access from another network requires remote-access setup.

terminal.title: Terminal access
terminal.description: Start work, watch live progress and resume conversations from your terminal. TUI is the full-screen interactive interface; CLI provides individual commands.
features: TUI: full-screen chat and live progress
steps: Install xopc and connect a model with xopc onboard --quick
Run xopc or xopc tui for full-screen conversation
Use xopc agent -i for simple interactive chat, or xopc agent -m "Your request" for one request
Resume with xopc resume; use xopc tui --gateway for remote sessions
terminal.boundary: The terminal is optional, not a prerequisite for coding. CLI installation needs a supported Node.js version. Remote Gateway connections require authentication; check which configuration and sessions each mode uses.

mobile.title: Mobile app
mobile.description: Pair with your computer and continue the same work from your phone.
steps: Choose Connect phone on the computer
Compare numbers and approve on the computer
mobile.boundary: Keep the computer running and online. Pending work is isolated by computer; stale or rejected entries need review.

channels.title: Messaging channels
channels.description: Collaborate with the same assistant through Telegram, Weixin or Feishu / Lark.
channels.boundary: Media support varies by channel. Channels such as Telegram and Weixin load through extensions.

chrome.title: Chrome extension
chrome.description: Bring Chat and current-page context into the browser sidebar.
chrome.boundary: Grant site access only as needed and verify the connection status.

remote.title: Remote access
remote.description: Reach your own xopc installation when you are away from its host.
remote.boundary: The Gateway defaults to loopback. Network access does not grant authority for actions inside the product.

privacy.title: Local-first privacy
privacy.description: Own persistent context and understand what selected information reaches a model.
steps: Choose a local or cloud model
privacy.boundary: Local-first does not mean every request is processed on your device.

permissions.title: Permissions & human decisions
permissions.description: Keep goals and judgment with the person while execution stays within explicit authority.
permissions.boundary: Sending, deleting, purchasing, publishing and other high-impact actions need explicit policy or approval.

storage.title: Local data & backup
storage.description: Keep conversations, tasks and personal context available for later recovery and management.
storage.boundary: Include both the database and workspace files. Follow the documented backup procedure.

logs.title: Logs & diagnostics
logs.description: Find the first useful cause when a connection, model or tool fails.
logs.boundary: Logs can contain work context. Review them before sharing.

settings.title: Preferences & settings
settings.description: Manage everyday experience, default capabilities and runtime configuration in their own sections.
settings.boundary: Explicit per-Agent overrides take precedence over global defaults.

gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.description: Connect clients, Agent execution and persistent local state.
gateway.boundary: Schedules, remote clients and periodic checks depend on Gateway availability.

coding.title: Coding & development
coding.description: Understand a codebase, change code, run checks and deliver reviewable results with the assistant. Start from desktop, the web console or a terminal.
features: Read and search code and project rules
Edit files in an authorized workspace
Run tests, builds and type checks
Review diffs and preserve verification records
steps: Set the codebase as the workspace and keep goals and context in a Project
Configure the Agent with the required model, file and command access
Describe the bug or feature and define completion criteria
Run project checks after edits and review the current workspace diff
Deliver a change summary, verification results and remaining issues
coding.boundary: Results depend on the model, tool permissions and project dependencies. A successful command does not prove every acceptance criterion passed. Full PTY and broader language services are still evolving; commits, pushes and deployments need explicit authorization.

journey1.title: Prepare a product launch
journey1.description: From a thought to a verifiable result

journey2.title: Build a weekly review
journey2.description: Reuse a method and schedule it

journey3.title: Ask the assistant to follow up

journey4.title: Complete a code change
journey4.description: Codebase and Project → Agent and tools → edits and verification → deliverable; continue in the terminal when useful.

layers.title: User entry points
layers.description: Start on desktop, then continue in a terminal, on your phone or in a messaging app.

layers.title: The product journey
layers.description: Meet, understand, collaborate and follow up. Human intent connects every step.

layers.title: Execution & reuse
layers.description: Agents define roles, tools provide actions, Skills teach methods, Workflows define steps and Automations decide when to start.

layers.title: Connections & runtime
layers.description: The Gateway connects interfaces and execution. Connectors, MCP and extensions add capabilities as needed.

layers.title: Data & trust
layers.description: Local state, evidence and memory support continuity. Authorization bounds every action.
